title: THREAT Matrix per-release ID manifest
description: Per-release inventory of every identifier a framework content release carries. The manifest is committed as docs/data/id-manifest.json, produced by scripts/lint/id-manifest.py from framework.json, and gated in CI. Comparing consecutive manifests audits the docs/IDENTIFIERS.md guarantee that identifiers are never reused or silently dropped: an ID present in release N must appear in release N+1, either in its namespace list or in reserved. Namespace lists carry every active, deprecated, and superseded ID. reserved carries every held identifier of any namespace: reserved actor profiles (the only objects that may be reserved inside framework.json in schema 3.0.0) and retired tactic, indicator, countermeasure, and response-protocol IDs, which are recorded only here. This schema enforces the ID grammar, that the five namespace lists are non-empty, and that no list repeats an ID. Two documented rules cannot be expressed in JSON Schema and are checked by scripts/lint/id-manifest.py --check: each list is sorted, and an ID appears in exactly one of its namespace list, reserved, or removed.

version.description: Framework content version (framework.json version) this manifest inventories.

generated.description: UTC timestamp (ISO 8601, second precision, Z suffix) at which the manifest was generated. The pattern bounds month, day, hour, minute, and second; it does not know month lengths.

reserved.description: Held identifiers from any namespace: reserved actor profiles and retired IDs of the other four namespaces. A reserved ID never also appears in its namespace list (checked by scripts/lint/id-manifest.py --check). May be empty.

removed.description: Optional. IDs withdrawn from the document, each with the release that removed it and a reason. A removed ID is never reused and never also appears in a namespace list or in reserved (checked by scripts/lint/id-manifest.py). Sorted by id.
